_note: Live derived metrics — updated each agent session. This is the source of truth for data-derived estimates. Do not use dashboard.json for TDEE or rate-of-loss; use this file. When any value changes, update it here in the same session.

tdee.method: back-calculated from Phase 1 weight loss — 6-week check-in (25 May 2026)
tdee.derivation: 84.1 kg (Apr 20 week-2 start) → 80.6 kg (7d avg May 25), 35 days. actual_daily_deficit = (84.1−80.6) × 7700 ÷ 35 = 770 kcal/day. TDEE = 770 + 1,435 avg intake = 2,205. Rounded to 2,200.
tdee.previous_estimate_note: 10 May estimate (27 days, pending validation). Revised upward by ~125 kcal at 6-week check-in.
tdee.algorithm_note: Mifflin-St Jeor / formula. Data-derived estimate supersedes this.
tdee.dashboard_note: Left unchanged as conservative anchor; this file's estimate is used for planning.
tdee.cardio_free_note: Gym + dog walks only. Structured cardio (runs, rides, stairs) is logged separately and treated as additive to the weekly deficit.
tdee.phase2_maintenance_note: Revised from 2,100 to 2,200 following 6-week validation. Use 2,200 kcal/day base for Phase 2 maintenance month planning.

phase2_validation.derivation: Week-2 start 79.8 kg (Mon 13 Jul) → 75.4 kg (7d avg 28 Aug), 46 days. actual_daily_deficit = (79.8−75.4) × 7700 ÷ 46 = 736 kcal/day. TDEE = 736 + 1,450 avg intake = 2,186.
phase2_validation.avg_intake_derivation: Phase 2 weekly deficit target 5,250 ÷ 7 = 750 kcal/day → 2,200 − 750 = 1,450 kcal/day. Matches dashboard meal-plan avg_daily_kcal of 1,448.
phase2_validation.note: Second independent validation of the 2,200 figure, now at 75–80 kg rather than the 84 kg of the Phase 1 derivation. 14 kcal below the working estimate is well inside noise, so no change. Caveat: the 1,450 avg intake assumes the phase tracked close to its 5,250 kcal/wk deficit target throughout — consistent with weekly carryover running ≈ 0, but not re-parsed week by week for this check.
phase2_validation.multiplier_note: Uses 7,700 kcal per kg of body fat — a rule of thumb, plausibly 7,000–9,000 depending on the fat/lean split of the loss. A ±10% swing in that figure moves the TDEE result by roughly ±74 kcal/day.

phase.name: Refeed — Bali
phase.status_note: Tracked active phase with direction "gain" and tracking_mode "balance" — not the untracked maintenance mode. Corrected 29 Aug.
phase.start_date_note: 29 Aug (Sat), not 28 Aug — Friday 28th was the cut's last day and its ramen cheat and walks belong to Phase 2. start_kg 74.8 is the cut's close weight (27 Aug reading carried through the 28th) so it predates start_date by a day, same handover convention as 6 Jul. Makes both meal-plan stages exactly 7 days.
phase.phase_mean_note: Mean of the 8 in-phase readings (29 Aug – 5 Sep). Trend within the phase is clearly DOWNWARD: first three readings mean 75.77, last three mean 74.77. The latest reading of 74.4 is BELOW the 74.8 phase start.
phase.rebound_progress_note: Reviewed 5 Sep, day 8 of 14. 74.8 (28 Aug, handover) → 75.5 → 76.0 → 75.8 → 75.8 → 74.9 → 75.1 → 74.8 → 74.4 (5 Sep). Peaked at 76.0 on 30 Aug and has fallen 1.6 kg since; 74.4 is BELOW the phase start. The 3 Sep read that the average was 'exactly on pace' has been overtaken by events — the in-phase mean is now 75.29 and the direction is unambiguous (first three readings 75.77, last three 74.77). The 76.5 kg goal will not be met: it needs +2.1 kg in 6 days.
phase.rebound_diagnosis_note: ROOT CAUSE, established 5 Sep: the phase is not failing on execution, it is failing on DESIGN. Over the 7 complete days (29 Aug – 4 Sep) Mathew beat his intake target every single day, averaging 2,163 kcal/day against a target average of 1,900 — 263/day ABOVE target. Yet the net energy balance was still 15,141 − (2,200 × 7) − 710 workout kcal = −969 kcal, i.e. −138 kcal/day, a genuine deficit. The reason is that Week 1's target was itself hypocaloric by construction: the 29 Aug plan declared a 2,100 kcal weekly deficit (= 0.27 kg) on the rationale that 'the rebound is driven by carbs going 200g → 300g, not by total energy'. That rationale was wrong on both halves. (1) YOU CANNOT STORE GLYCOGEN IN AN ENERGY DEFICIT — carbohydrate eaten in a deficit is oxidised for fuel, not banked. (2) The carbs never arrived either: weekday carbs ran ~170–180g against the declared 200–250g band, because the banana was rejected on 29 Aug (−27g) and the oats were halved on 1 Sep (−21g). Actual loss of 0.40 kg vs the 0.27 kg the plan itself predicted, so the scale is behaving close to design. Waist confirms the null result: 95 cm on 3 Sep, unchanged from 95 cm on 27 Aug. Conclusion: eight days in, the refeed has not meaningfully happened.
phase.rebound_forward_note: 6 days remain to the 12 Sep flight. Week 2 as declared (2,100 weekday / 2,450 weekend, avg 2,200) is EXACTLY maintenance and therefore still will not build glycogen — it stops the loss but does not reverse it. Reaching 76.5 would require ~525g of glycogen plus ~1,575g of bound water at the 1:3 ratio, i.e. storing ~88g of carbohydrate per day above oxidation for six consecutive days; that is carb-loading-protocol territory (8–10 g/kg/day), not 'eat normally', and it is not going to happen. Recommended instead, pending Mathew's decision: (a) revise or drop the 76.5 target — it was incompatible with the plan's own Week 1 deficit from the day both were written; (b) for the final 6 days run a genuine surplus of ~200–300 kcal/day (≈2,400–2,500) with carbs at 250–300g, which costs at most 1,800 kcal ≈ 0.23 kg of fat if none of it is stored as glycogen — a trivial downside for the stated goal; (c) judge the outcome on how he FEELS and on waist, not on the scale. Note Week 2 requires eating MORE than he managed in Week 1 (2,200 vs 2,163 average) while the plan items deliver only 1,480 weekday / 1,509 weekend, leaving gaps of 620 and 941 kcal/day.
phase.rebound_risk_note: SUPERSEDED 5 Sep by rebound_diagnosis_note — the risk it described has materialised. Original text: the live risk is carbohydrate, not energy; weekday carbs ~160g against the 200–250g band after the oats halving; intake made up with fat-heavy restaurant food so hitting the kcal target does not guarantee hitting the carb band; UNVERIFIABLE from the log, which stores only kcal per cheat and no macros. The 3 Sep prediction was that if 76.5 kg were missed, insufficient carbs at energy balance would be the cause. That was half right: carbs were short AND the energy balance was a deficit rather than balance, so both legs failed. The macro blind spot remains the single most useful thing to fix in the app — a phase whose objective is a carbohydrate target cannot be steered from a log that records only calories.

week1.derivation: Round numbers with the same +350 weekend uplift as Week 2. Weekly total = 1,800 × 5 + 2,150 × 2 = 9,000 + 4,300 = 13,300, average 1,900 — 7 kcal/day above the original ramp average of 1,893, i.e. immaterial. Daily deltas vs 2,200 maintenance: +400 weekday, +50 weekend → weekly deficit 5 × 400 + 2 × 50 = 2,100 kcal. Running mildly hypocaloric in week 1 is intended: the rebound is driven by carbs going 200g → 300g, not by total energy. Chosen over the exact-1,893 alternative (1,793 / 2,143) for roundness.

week2.derivation: Mathew's own figures. Weekly total = 2,100 × 5 + 2,450 × 2 = 10,500 + 4,900 = 15,400, average exactly 2,200. Daily deltas vs maintenance: +100 weekday, −250 weekend → 5 × 100 − 2 × 250 = 0, i.e. true energy balance. Supersedes the earlier 2,129 / 2,379, which averaged 2,200.4 and left a 3 kcal residue.

intake_plan.phase_total: 13,300 + 15,400 = 28,700 kcal over 14 days = 2,050/day average. Cumulative deficit 2,100 kcal ≈ 0.27 kg of fat at the 7,700 kcal/kg rule of thumb — negligible against the 1.7 kg glycogen-and-water target.
intake_plan.weekday_breakfast: Settled 29 Aug, trimmed 30 Aug, HALVED 1 Sep: the weekday Double Shake (232 kcal, 42g protein) was replaced by Overnight Oats on ALL weekdays of the phase. Current build — 35g dry porridge oats, 1 scoop Impact Whey, 40g Fage 0%, 5g (1 tsp) powdered peanut butter, water to loosen = 289 kcal, 31g protein, ~24g carbs. Weekday base is 1,423 − 232 + 289 = 1,480, protein 144g. History: bowl was 552 (20g PB), then 517 (PB cut to 10g, 30 Aug), then 289 (halved, 1 Sep). The halving was for palatability, not calories — Mathew ate only half the bowl on 31 Aug and described it as hard work. The build cuts bulk rather than everything proportionally: dropping the Oatly and shrinking the oats and Fage while keeping the whole whey scoop retains 31g of the 43g protein, where a straight halving would have left 21.5g. Consequences, both accepted knowingly: daily protein 156 → 144g, below the 150g target (still ~1.9 g/kg at 75.8 kg); and weekday carbs fall to ~160g against Week 1's 200–250g band, which is the bigger cost because the rebound is carb-driven rather than energy-driven.
intake_plan.powdered_peanut_butter_product: Hale Naturals defatted peanut flour, 180g jar, 15 × 12g servings. Per 100g: 398 kcal, 48g protein, 26g carbs (17g sugars), 9g fat, 10g fibre, 0.84g salt. So 5g = 20 kcal / 2.4g protein, 10g = 40 / 4.8, 20g = 80 / 9.6. Sweetened with palmyra nectar powder (second ingredient), hence sugars at 65% of carbs — immaterial at 10g but the macros shift if the brand changes to an unsweetened flour. The 5g / 1 tsp portion is in logs/components.json for the meal builder.
intake_plan.outstanding: Both the weekend food and the weekdays, after the 1 Sep oats halving. Over the current base (1,480 weekday / 1,509 weekend): Week 1 needs +320 weekday and +641 weekend; Week 2 needs +620 weekday and +941 weekend. Week 1's planned week is 5 × 1,480 + 2 × 1,509 = 10,418 vs the declared 13,300 — a 2,882 kcal gap, split 1,600 weekday (56%) and 1,282 weekend (44%). The weekend was the binding constraint at the 1,708 base (74% of the gap) but is no longer: the five weekdays now contribute slightly more, and 1,600 exceeds the card's 750 tolerance on its own. Week 2 is worse at 4,982 (5 × 620 + 2 × 941), i.e. 4,982 ÷ 7,700 ≈ 0.65 kg of glycogen and tissue not refed, and with Bali on 12 Sep there is no third week to recover it. Mathew chose on 1 Sep not to add plan items to close the weekday gap, filling it with tracked additions instead — defensible, since the plan is a floor and logged extras have covered it so far (31 Aug's Wagamama alone was 1,150 kcal), but it means the plan no longer states the day's headroom in advance. Weekend protein is also weak at 124g vs the 150g target — the weekend shake is a single scoop; a double adds 148 kcal and 21g protein, taking it to 145g.

phase.expected_rebound_note: REVISED 5 Sep — the original expectation (scale settling at 76–77 kg by 4 Sep and holding) did not happen; the 4 Sep reading was 74.8 and 5 Sep 74.4. See rebound_diagnosis_note. The waist half of the test did hold, as a null result: 95 cm on 3 Sep, unchanged from 95 cm on 27 Aug, consistent with neither fat gain nor meaningful glycogen repletion.

completed_phase_result.name: Fat Loss — Bali (Phase 2)
completed_phase_result.end_note: Closed 2 days early (planned 30 Aug). 28 Aug weight is the 27 Aug reading carried forward — no weigh-in was taken on the 28th.
completed_phase_result.loss_rate_derivation: 80.4 → 74.8 kg = −5.6 kg in 53 days = 5.6 ÷ 53 × 7 = 0.74 kg/wk on end-point weights. On 7-day averages: 80.4 → 75.4 = −5.0 kg = 0.66 kg/wk, which is the more conservative and more honest figure.
completed_phase_result.target_verdict: Live target was 75.0 kg by 30 Aug. Ended at 74.8 kg on end-point weight, 75.4 kg on 7-day average — target met.
completed_phase_result.waist_change_note: 108 cm (15 Apr baseline) → 95 cm (27 Aug). Down 1 cm from the 96 cm reading on 18 Aug. Primary success metric per the reframed 2026 criteria.
completed_phase_result.early_close_rationale: Two remaining days carried a base deficit of 2 × (2,200 − 1,509) = 1,382 kcal ≈ 0.18 kg of fat — smaller than daily scale noise, against a weekend of social commitments. Ending Friday and starting the refeed early costs nothing measurable and buys a longer, gentler ramp into Bali.

vo2_max.note: Watch VO2 last 7 days oscillated 37.48–37.94 (latest 37.51). Run HR has recovered: Aug 4 156 bpm → Aug 18 148 → Aug 20 146 at the same ~20 min / ~2.3 km pace, so the Aug 4 heat-suppression read is no longer the story. Jun 4 absolute baseline 2,998 mL/min ÷ 75.5 kg 7d avg = 39.71 theoretical if fitness held. Watch 37.51 is 2.20 below that (75.5×37.51=2,832 absolute). Day-to-day Watch VO2 is noisy; RHR 52.7 and run HR 146 are the cleaner cardio signals.
